examples.label: Cookie notice along the bottom of the page
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-drawer" site="Global" id="drawer-cookie-notice" title="We use cookies" position="bottom" size="small" variant="default" color="dark" show={true}>

Essential cookies keep the site running. Optional ones tell us which articles people actually finish reading. You can change your choice at any time from the link in the footer.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" size="small">Accept all <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="white" size="small">Essential only
